references.text: The prophecy that the Messiah would live in Capernaum, which is located in the territories of Zebulun and Naphtali, is fulfilled in Matthew 4:13.
Matthew 4:13 fulfills the prophecy in Isaiah by showing that Jesus settled in Capernaum, which is located in the territories of Zebulun and Naphtali, to bring light to the people there.
